sections.heading: Define what 'ready for paint' means
body: Ask the ceiling installer to state which joints, fasteners and edges will be treated and what surface condition is handed to the painter. Confirm whether any additional primer, filling or sanding is required, and who performs it. A shared sample or written finish description can reduce differing expectations.

Inspect the ceiling in the actual room under diffuse light and the planned fittings where possible. Look for an even plane, clean corners and accurately formed openings. Record items that need correction before the painter starts.

sections.heading: Protect details and coordinate cut-outs
body: Confirm each opening against the selected light or fan model. Ask who provides the final cut-out measurements and who repairs an opening if a fitting changes. Keep the electrician involved in wiring and support decisions for the actual installation.
Protect finished edges and surfaces during later work. If carpentry or other trades still need to access the ceiling, agree how they will do so without damaging the paint-ready surface.

sections.heading: Keep the approved scope with the estimate
body: A complete estimate identifies board and framing, joint treatment, paint, cut-outs, access, protection and clean-up. Note whether the amount assumes measured dimensions and how additions are approved.
Share the room plan, photos and finish expectation with Arsh Interiors. The site lists gypsum and false-ceiling work in Pune; confirm current availability at the exact Undri address.
